text_block_list.text:
――A day off.
I was planning on buying a book for
training, 
and then keeping the rest of the day
casual……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Hello~ 
……Back from the bookstore?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh~…… I can't read the title because it's
got so many difficult 
kanji. Something something,
priority…… -metry-……?
choice_data_list: A book we can use for training

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see.
……Even thinking about training on your day
off, 
as usual you're quite enthusiastic, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Hmmmm~.
It's something for me…… wouldn't it 
be better for me to tag along?
Doesn't feel 
right to just leave with a 『Good Work』)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, where are you heading next? 
Got some more shopping to do?

I hadn't really decided on anything yet but,
I told her 
I was thinking about seeing a movie or doing
some karaoke.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh, so normal……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahaha. No,
I didn't mean that in a bad way. 
I see,
I see. Then~…… how about going together?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I happen to have some free time. 
So will you let me go with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~. Really,
being able to let loose like that 
feels good~.
We have lessons for our Lives too but, 
I guess karaoke feels a bit different.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't ask something so obvious~!
Of course I'd be nervous! 
Every single time,
I'm always quaking in my boots.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And if I were to mess up,
it'd cause trouble for everyone 
else~. My voice is so shaky too.
And when everyone around me is so perfect,
I get even more nervous~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
On top of that,
the stage is a really special place, 
isn't it?
It's not an atmosphere you'd be in
normally……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
there's also fun and interesting parts,
but the nerves are no joke~.
Just thinking about it gets my heart
pumping……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is! Trainer-san, 
you should try standing there sometime――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Oh, it's the next song. 
I've been practicing this song――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wai-!?
W-what are you doing all of a sudden? 
Ah, are you cheering!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not really a cheer though!? Ahaa,
ahahaha! 
Stop it!
I can't sing if you're making me laugh~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuu～～～…… That one just now,
was probably 
the best song so far, don't you think?
choice_data_list: You're so good! I wanna hear more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't just make me do it,
Trainer-san you should sing too!
choice_data_list: A cheer song for Hishi Miracle……!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah…… wait,
there's no way there's a song like that――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're just gonna sing acapella!? 
Ahahahaa, c'mon, stop that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa-…… that was fun……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What,
why are you the one with the self-satisfied
smirk on 
your face~? Halfway through,
I was just laughing, you know.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just having fun……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well~ I did think you were letting 
it go to your head though~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……But,
it didn't really bother me though. 
I can tell they mean it when they're praising
me, I guess)
choice_data_list: All that singing made me hungry

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Same here~. 
How about heading to a family restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a poster about the kid's meal…… Do you
ever feel 
like just getting one sometimes?
A kid's meal I mean.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~? I wonder why that is.
And then there's something 
you just have to get if you come to a family
restaurant――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. Anyways,
getting fries is a must. 
Trainer-san, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Something you always have to order……ah, 
or maybe some kind of weird mix you make
with your drink?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see~. Now I don't do it but, 
a loooo~ng time ago,
what my friends and I used to do――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huuu~. We ended up eating quite a lot,
huh? 
Ate alot, and talked alot……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It almost felt like when I'm with my friends,
I guess……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing. It's just that…… 
I thought Trainer-san would feel more like
a teacher.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Like I would get nervous while talking to
you, or feel some kind of distance…… kinda
like 
between an adult and a kid.
Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But, I really don't get that feeling from
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that it helps.
It makes things easier. 
And I don't feel like I have to think too
hard about it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……but well,
it feels more like you're the one being 
considerate of me,
so that might be why it's easier.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. It's probably about time we head back.
I laughed a 
bit too much today,
so I'll probably get a good night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(…… normally, this is how most days go.
But when there's a 
race,
I really can feel the difference in passion,
huh?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I want to do my best to live up to
expectations, 
and I'm working hard but…… I wonder what 
Trainer-san thinks about that difference)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I can't match that passion,
I do want to close that gap,
even if just a little though~. Hmmm, 
maybe some kind of gratitude for being so
passionate?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, that would feel kind of weird. 
Not like that, maybe something more……)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe some kind of present……? No,
would something 
like that be weird~? They'd be like 『But,
why?』 huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm~, mmmmm~…… it's so hard~……

Hishi Miracle was beside me mumbling to
herself. 
I wonder if something's wrong.
I'd like it if 
she wouldn't hesitate to consult me……

From what I could hear, maybe she's 
worried about gifts for her friends.

Then I guess I don't need to worry too
much. 
While gazing at the sunset, I matched my 
pace with Hishi Miracle as we headed back.
